name: hit-perfect
prompt: A bright crystalline mallet strike on a small glass chime, sharp attack with a short shimmering ring-out, clean and rewarding.

name: hit-great
prompt: A firm wooden percussion tap with a quick bright overtone, like a xylophone bar struck once, short decay.

name: hit-good
prompt: A soft muted drumstick tap on a practice pad, dry and quick, neutral positive feedback.

name: combo-milestone
prompt: A rising harp glissando ending on a small bell chime, celebratory but compact, sparkling arpeggio sweep.

name: hold-tick
prompt: A very short quiet tick of a clockwork mechanism, soft wooden click, gentle and unobtrusive.

name: miss
prompt: A dull thud of a hand slapping cardboard followed by a brief low buzzer groan, disappointing but not harsh.

name: empty-hit
prompt: A single hollow knock on empty plastic, airy and dry, very short, signaling a swing at nothing.

name: countdown-tick
prompt: A crisp metronome click, mechanical woodblock snap, precise and centered, for counting in.

name: countdown-go
prompt: A bright starting-gun style chime, a single resonant ping on a metal triangle, energetic and clear.

name: ui-move
prompt: A soft interface tick like a fingernail flicking a small toggle switch, light and quick.

name: ui-confirm
prompt: A satisfying pop of a button being pressed on a well-made device, small rising plasticky chirp.

name: ui-back
prompt: A gentle reverse whoosh, like a page of a book being flipped back, soft falling swish.

name: ui-error
prompt: A short dull buzz from a small electric doorbell buzzer, muted and brief, signaling rejection.

name: fanfare-win
prompt: A short triumphant brass fanfare, four rising trumpet notes with a warm final chord, celebratory jingle.

name: fanfare-loss
prompt: A gentle descending trombone phrase, three falling notes, sympathetic and comedic rather than punishing.
